title: 手枪
subject: pistol
reference_side: its left side, muzzle pointing right
convention: Object frame: +X = muzzle direction, +Y = up, +Z = toward the camera of the reference view. A view at azimuth az / elevation el (degrees) looks at the origin from direction (sin az cos el, sin el, cos az cos el); image right = (cos az, 0, -sin az), image up = view direction x image right.

views.name: front
views.label: 正面
views.camera: Front view: the camera looks straight down the barrel into the muzzle. The barrel points directly at the camera, so the muzzle opening is in the center and the slide and grip are hidden behind it, foreshortened to nothing. The grip extends downward behind the muzzle. The left side of the pistol (the side visible in the reference) is on the LEFT edge of the image.

views.name: right
views.label: 右侧
views.camera: Exact right-side profile: the pistol is turned around 180 degrees on a turntable, so we now see its RIGHT side, with the muzzle pointing LEFT and the grip at the right. It is the opposite viewpoint of the reference: show the other face of the object (the right wooden grip panel and the right face of the black metal body), not a mirrored copy of the reference.

views.name: back
views.label: 背面
views.camera: Rear view: the camera is directly behind the pistol, looking along the barrel toward the muzzle, which points straight away from the camera. We see the back of the slide with the rear sight and hammer at the top and the back strap of the grip below. The left side of the pistol (the side visible in the reference) is on the RIGHT edge of the image.

views.name: top
views.label: 顶部
views.camera: Top-down view: the camera is directly above the pistol looking straight down at the top of the slide. The muzzle points RIGHT. The left side of the pistol (the side visible in the reference) faces the BOTTOM edge of the image. The grip is hidden below the slide; only its outline may peek out.

views.name: bottom
views.label: 底部
views.camera: Bottom-up view: the camera is directly below the pistol looking straight up. We see the underside: the base of the grip (magazine floor plate), the underside of the trigger guard and the underside of the frame and barrel. The muzzle points RIGHT. The left side of the pistol (the side visible in the reference) faces the TOP edge of the image.

views.name: fl45
views.label: 左前
views.camera: Front three-quarter view of the left side: starting from the reference, the pistol is turned 45 degrees on a turntable so that its muzzle comes toward the camera. We see the left side foreshortened and the front face of the muzzle. The muzzle is on the right side of the image, closer to the camera; the grip is on the left. The camera stays level with the pistol.

views.name: fr135
views.label: 右前
views.camera: Front three-quarter view of the right side: the pistol shows its RIGHT side turned 45 degrees so that the muzzle comes toward the camera. The muzzle is on the LEFT side of the image, closer to the camera; the grip is on the right. The camera stays level with the pistol.

views.name: br225
views.label: 右后
views.camera: Rear three-quarter view of the right side: the pistol shows its RIGHT side turned 45 degrees so that the muzzle points away from the camera. The muzzle is on the LEFT side of the image, farther from the camera; the grip, hammer and back of the slide are on the right, closer to the camera. The camera stays level with the pistol.

views.name: bl315
views.label: 左后
views.camera: Rear three-quarter view of the left side: starting from the reference, the pistol is turned 45 degrees so that its muzzle points away from the camera. The muzzle is on the RIGHT side of the image, farther from the camera; the grip, hammer and back of the slide are on the left, closer to the camera. The camera stays level with the pistol.

views.name: hl30
views.label: 左前上方
views.camera: High front three-quarter view of the left side: the camera is raised 35 degrees above the pistol and moved 30 degrees around toward the muzzle, looking down at it. We see the top of the slide and the left side, with the muzzle on the right side of the image.

views.name: hr150
views.label: 右前上方
views.camera: High front three-quarter view of the right side: the camera is raised 35 degrees above the pistol, looking down at its RIGHT side from slightly in front. We see the top of the slide and the right side, with the muzzle on the LEFT side of the image, a little closer to the camera.

views.name: hr210
views.label: 右后上方
views.camera: High rear three-quarter view of the right side: the camera is raised 35 degrees above the pistol, looking down at its RIGHT side from slightly behind. We see the top of the slide, the hammer and the right side, with the muzzle on the LEFT side of the image, a little farther from the camera.

views.name: hl330
views.label: 左后上方
views.camera: High rear three-quarter view of the left side: the camera is raised 35 degrees above the pistol, looking down at its left side from slightly behind. We see the top of the slide, the hammer and the left side, with the muzzle on the RIGHT side of the image, a little farther from the camera.
